label: Cat breed
description: Domestic cat breeds and everyday nonpedigree kinds, grouped by coat structure and approximate adult size.
notes: Breed identity and everyday domestic coat-length kinds belong here, phrased as names before cat. animal.cat_coat owns color and pattern choices; animal.species owns other animals. Coat chips describe breed varieties, including both lengths where appropriate, while size is a broad adult comparison. Glosses describe recognizable breed tendencies rather than promising that every individual has the same markings.
